day_local: Jimcaha Toddobaadka Afraad iyo Soddonka ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, jacaylka Ilaaha Aabbaha ah, iyo wada-jirka Ruuxa Quduuska ah ha idinla jiraan.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Rabbiyow, waxaad tahay hoygayaga jiilba jiil.
homily:
Bal ka fikir adigoo taagan beerta dhexdeeda xilliga gu'ga, adigoo daawanaya geedka berdeha ah oo si tartiib ah u soo bixinaya burooyinkiisa. Waxaa jira wax dagan oo rajo leh oo ku saabsan in la arko nolosha oo dib u soo noolaanaysa, caleemaha yaryar oo u soo dillaacaya dhanka qorraxda. Waxaad ogtahay in xagaagu dhow yahay. Waa calaamad yar, laakiin waa mid hubaal ah. Ciise wuxuu maanta Injiilka inoo sheegayaa in xitaa marka dunidu ay u muuqato mid isbedelaysa, in Boqortooyada Ilaah ay mar walba soo dhowdahay. Waxaan ku jirnaa xilli aan raadineyno calaamadaha Ilaah ee nolosheenna, xitaa marka aynaan si buuxda u fahmi karin waxa dhacaya.

Benjamin Vo, wiilkeenna qaaliga ah, wuxuu ahaa wiil mar walba 'indhaha u furan' xagga waxyaalaha cusub. Wuxuu jeclaa inuu barto sida wax u shaqeeyaan, ha ahaato koodhka uu ku qorayay github-kiisa, ama sida ay diyaaraduhu ugu kacaan hawada. Waxaan xusuustaa inuu lahaa riyo uu ugu magac daray 'con chim airlines'. Markuu ka hadlayay shirkaddan uu ku riyoonayay, wuxuu had iyo jeer ku darsan jiray qosol iyo dhoola caddayn. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil leh maskax aad u dhalaalaya, laakiin waxaa ka sii qurux badnaa qalbiyadiisa oo u furnaa adduunka. Wuxuu ahaa wiil jecel inuu dadka kale ka farxiyo, wiil leh naxariis aan xad lahayn.

Maanta, akhriska koowaad ee kitaabka Muujintii, Yooxanaa wuxuu arkay 'samada cusub iyo dhulka cusub.' Wuxuu arkay magaalada quduuska ah, Yeruusaalemta cusub, oo ka soo degaysa xagga Ilaah, 'sida aroosad loo qurxiyey ninkeedii.' Waa sawirka rajada ugu dambaysa. Wax kasta oo aan halkan ku aragno, xitaa waxyaalaha ugu quruxda badan, waa kuwo ku meel gaar ah. Laakiin ballanqaadka Ilaah waa mid aan marnaba lumin. Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Samada iyo dhulku way gudbi doonaan, laakiin ereyadaydu ma gudbi doonaan.' Ereyga Ilaah waa kan inagu haya marka aan dareemno in dunidu ay naga go'ayso.

Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in shan bilood ay yihiin kuwo culus. Waxaa jira waqtiyo marka aad dareemaysaan in booska Ben uu yahay mid bannaan, saacado marka aad xusuusataan dhoola caddayntiisa ama sida uu u jeclaa inuu qoslo markaad ka hadlaysaan 'con chim airlines.' Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan waqtiyo aad dareemaysaan in dunidiinnu ay u muuqato mid isbedelaysa, sidii geedka oo kale xilliga dayrta. Laakiin fadlan, halkan ku hakada. Maanta, kelmadda Ilaah waxay ku leedahay qalbigaaga: Adigu keligaa ma tihid. Ben wuxuu hadda ku dhex nool yahay 'Yeruusaalemta cusub' ee Yooxanaa arkay, meel aanay jirin ilmo ama murugo. Jacaylkiinna, dadaalkiinnii, iyo sida aad u koriseen wiilkan cajiibka ah waa mid aan marnaba lumin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay weligiis.

Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil doonayay inuu bixiyo wax kasta oo uu haysto. Xusuusta uu aabbihiis ka sheegay ee ku saabsan sida uu u rabay inuu dhiibo sanduuqiisa lacagta si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William, waa tusaale saafi ah oo ah wiil qalbigiisu uu furnaa. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqaydiisa, mana loo baahnayn in la jebiyo, laakiin dalabkaas saafi ah—wiil yar oo unprompted ah oo doonayay inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto si uu qof u caawiyo—waa muraayadda jacaylka saafi ah ee Masiixu inaga raba. Ilaah ma eego waxa aan bixino, wuxuu eegaa sida aan u bixinno. Ben wuxuu bixiyay qalbigiisa oo dhan, taasna waa waxa maanta ka dhigaya inuu ku dhex noolaado jannada.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, ogow inuusan Ben kaa fogayn. Wuxuu weli ku jiraa qalbigaaga. Wuxuu weli kula joogaa markaad ciyaarayso, markaad wax baranayso, iyo markaad seexanayso. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu xasuusan jiray markii ay wada safrayeen ama ay wada ciyaarayeen. Jacaylkaagu waa mid sii socon doona oo aan dhamaanayn. Ilaah wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inaan 'u adeegsanno' waxa la inoo dhiibay—jacaylka, xusuusta, iyo nolosha—si aan u dhisno boqortooyada Ilaah. Ben wuxuu inoo baray inaan ku kalsoonaano Ilaah.

Marka aad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ka helay irridda xigmadda iyo nabadda Jannada, halkaas oo aanay jirin ilmeyn ama daal. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in iimaankaagu uusan dhammaan doonin, maxaa yeelay Ilaah waa kan ku siinaya xoog maalin kasta. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay weligiis. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sacrament-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa jeclahay wax walba, waxaana rabaa inaan naftayda kuugu dhiibo. Maadaama aanan hadda si dhab ah kuu aqbali karin, fadlan qalbigayga ku soo deg adigoo ruuxi ah. Waxaan kugu duubayaa sidii adigoo horey u joogay, waxaana naftayda u hurayaa adiga oo dhan. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa fogaado. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin dhowro, oo ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa weligeed ah. Nabadda Rabbiga ha idinla jirto had iyo goor.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii ka horreeyey ee dhintay, inuu Rabbigu u furo albaabada jannada oo uu siiyo nabad weligeed ah, waxaan Rabbiga ka baryaynaa.
Qoyska iyo dhammaan kuwa murugaysan, inuu Ilaah u soo dejiyo nabad iyo rajo, oo uu qalbigooda ku xoojiyo jacaylkiisa, waxaan Rabbiga ka baryaynaa.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Aniga, Yooxanaa, waxaan arkay malaa'ig ka soo degaysa samada, oo gacanta ku haysa furaha yaamayska iyo silsilad weyn. Wuxuu qabtay abeesadii hore, oo ah Ibliis ama Shaydaan, wuxuuna ku xidhay kun sano, wuxuuna ku tuuray yaamayska, oo uu ku xidhay, si aanu mar dambe u marin habaabin quruumaha ilaa kunka sano ka dhammaanayaan. Intaas ka dib, waa in la sii daayaa wakhti yar. Markaas ayaan arkay carshiyo; kuwii ku fadhiyey waxaa loo dhiibay xukunka. Waxaan kaloo arkay nafihii kuwii loo gooyey markhaatifurka Ciise iyo ereyga Ilaah, kuwaas oo aan caabudin bahalkii ama sawirkiisii, oo aan aqbalin calaamadiisii fooddooda ama gacmahooda. Way soo noolaadeen oo waxay la boqreen Masiixii kun sano. Markaas ayaan arkay carshi weyn oo cad iyo kii ku fadhiyey. Dhulka iyo samadu way ka carareen joogitaankiisa, meelna uma ay helin. Waxaan arkay kuwii dhintay, kuwa waaweyn iyo kuwa yaryar, oo taagan carshiga hortiisa, oo duubab baa la furay. Markaas waxaa la furay duub kale, oo ah kitaabka nolosha. Kuwii dhintay waxaa lagu xukumay falalkoodii, iyadoo loo eegayo wixii ku qornaa duubabka. Baddii waxay bixisay kuwii dhintay; markaas Dhimashadii iyo Hades waxay bixiyeen kuwii dhintay. Dhammaan kuwii dhintay waxaa lagu xukumay falalkoodii. Markaas Dhimashadii iyo Hades waxaa lagu tuuray balligii dabka ahaa. (Balligan dabka ah waa dhimashada labaad.) Qof kasta oo magaciisu aanu ku qornayn kitaabka nolosha waxaa lagu tuuray balliga dabka. Markaas ayaan arkay samada cusub iyo dhulka cusub. Samadii hore iyo dhulkii hore way dhammaadeen, baddiina mar dambe ma jirin. Waxaan kaloo arkay magaaladii quduuska ahayd, Yeruusaalemta cusub, oo ka soo degaysa xagga samada oo ka imanaysa Ilaah, oo loo diyaariyey sida aroosad loo qurxiyey ninkeedii.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu xertiisii u sheegay masaal. 'Bal ka fiiriya geedka berdeha ah iyo dhammaan geedaha kale. Marka burooyinkoodu soo dillaacaan, waad aragtaan oo waad og tihiin in xagaagu dhow yahay; si la mid ah, markaad aragtaan waxyaalahan oo dhacaya, ogaada in Boqortooyada Ilaah ay dhowdahay. Aamiin, waxaan idin leeyahay, jiilkan ma gudbi doono ilaa waxyaalahan oo dhami ay dhacaan. Samada iyo dhulku way gudbi doonaan, laakiin ereyadaydu ma gudbi doonaan.'

day: Friday of the Thirty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Sad
pet_prayers.text: Miss you kid! We are in Taiwan right now. Thinking of you everywhere we go. Mom cries almost every day over here

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
